resale_co.how_to_apply: No Township resale inspection. The Township's Construction Code page sends sellers to the NJ DCA online smoke detector and carbon monoxide certification.

evidence.quote: The Construction Department does not do inspections for resale of residential or non-residential structures.
Dory Cooper Construction Official 2100 Tuckahoe Road, Petersburg, NJ 08270 constructioncode@uppertownship.com (609) 628-2011 Ext: 225

resale_co.notes: The Township says in writing that its Construction Department does not inspect on resale; the only resale item it points to is the state smoke/CO certificate. Office hours 8:30 AM to 4:00 PM, Monday through Friday. Township code (ecode360 UP4118) was not checked for other transfer rules.

requirements: State online self-certification (CSACMASPSIL): smoke alarms, carbon monoxide alarms, and the secondary power source identification label for homes with solar, generators or batteries; the current state application no longer lists a fire extinguisher

authorities.name: NJ DCA Division of Fire Safety, Bureau of Fire Code Enforcement
authorities.area_served: Entire township (all four fire company areas: Marmora, Seaville, Strathmere, Tuckahoe)
authorities.lead_time: More than 10 business days before closing for the lowest fee

fees.label: More than 10 business days before closing
fees.quote: If you are applying for a certificate more than ten business days from the closing date the fee is $45 dollars

fees.label: 4 to 10 business days before closing
fees.quote: if applying 4 to 10 business days from the closing date the fee is $90

fees.label: Less than 4 business days before closing
fees.quote: if the closing date is less than four business days the fee is $161.

authorities.how_to_apply: Apply online through the NJ DCA Fire Safety portal ('Start Your Smoke Certification Application'). Pay by e-check or credit card before submitting; a valid email address is required. The certificate is emailed once the application is submitted, the fee is paid and any required inspections are done. Homes heated by electricity with no CO alarm requirement should also email BFCE_CSDCMAC@dca.nj.gov.
authorities.contact_title: Bureau Chief, Bureau of Fire Code Enforcement (listed as the Fire Official in the state fire directory)

fire_cert.notes: NJ DCA lists Upper Township as State enforced (S) and its July 17, 2026 list marks it 'SC' (the State issues smoke certificates). The Township's Construction Code page links to the DCA Fire Safety portal for the 'Smoke Detector & Carbon Monoxide Certification for home resale'. The state fire directory lists all four fire companies (Marmora, Seaville, Strathmere, Tuckahoe) with the State as enforcing agency and 'NJ Division Fire Safety' for smoke detector compliance. The directory gives (609) 633-6132 for Louis Kilmer; the Bureau's own page gives (609) 633-6106, which is used here.
